title: Haye zindaan tera watan
body:
Haye zindaan tera watan
Meri mazloom behna Sakina
Meri masoom behna Sakina
Bole Sajjad laasha uthakar
Sakina..x2
(Haye zindaan tera watan ban gaya
<<MINI>>
Khoo'n bhara tera kurta kafan ban gaya)..(2)
